# Offline UX Kit

> Add consent-aware local UX telemetry, categorized feedback, and self-contained reports to offline HTML and static web prototypes.

## Primary instructions

- SKILL.md: https://github.com/Fable-Forge/offline-ux-kit/blob/main/SKILL.md
- Installation: https://github.com/Fable-Forge/offline-ux-kit/blob/main/docs/install.md
- Update: https://github.com/Fable-Forge/offline-ux-kit/blob/main/docs/update.md
- Validation status: https://github.com/Fable-Forge/offline-ux-kit/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md

## Install

`npx skills add Fable-Forge/offline-ux-kit`
